text:
marta: heads up — customer reported a tiny unexpected token bump after a prefetch + resume during streaming (about ~12 tokens). anyone seen this pattern before?
noah: was it a toolcall or straight generation?
marta: toolcall. sequence was: prefetch sidecar issues provisional, node drained, reconnect routes to different coordinator/model, toolcall started then truncated EOF mid-tool. ledger shows both provisional and confirmed tool charges.
noah: can you paste the log snippet?
marta: snippet: ```INFO ledger: session=xyz789 event=provisional_charge type=tool tokens=14 prefix_len=2
INFO connect: session=xyz789 route_hint=blue-experimental reconnect=true
INFO ledger: session=xyz789 event=confirmed_charge type=tool tokens=26 confirmed=true route=redwood-v1
```
tara: that fits a race: provisional recorded before handoff; confirmation goes through a different path which doesn't dedupe against the provisional. our dedupe keys are (session_id, type, confirmed) today.
kylo: the provisional comes from the sidecar and never surfaces to the coordinator that does the confirmed write. so both end up in the ledger.
ops-bot: Alert: 1 account affected; estimated exposure $0.00045.
noah: quick mitigation: when ingesting a confirmed_charge, look for a provisional within a small window (10s) with matching prefix_len and tool id; if found, mark confirmed as merged instead of emitting separate billing. risk: could hide legit back-to-back tool invocations.
tara: agree. we should emit metrics: charge_merge_candidates, merge_applied, merge_conflicts. additionally, add route_hint and session_phase (prefetch/resume) to ledger events so we can debug without guessing.
kylo: UI: token waterfall should show a tiny merged badge on the confirmed event and a hover that shows provisional vs confirmed token counts + route hints. also link to raw trace.
marta: plan: noah to implement ingest-side tentative merge behind a feature flag + tests; tara to update console timeline UX; kylo to add alerting on merge_conflicts. canary for a single tenant first.
oah: will open PR today: ledger: add session_phase and route_hint fields; ingest: implement tentative merge logic behind flag; emit metrics as discussed; include replay harness unit tests. ETA tomorrow AM.
tara: i'll file the console ticket and sketch hover copy.
kylo: i'll add a Grafana panel showing merge rates and a threshold alert for merge_conflicts.
marta: thanks all. tagging @billing-squad for visibility. :thumbsup:
